# wesley's open source
> https://oss.wesleymatos.dev — catalog of Wesley Matos's open-source work.
> 77 projects, generated 2026-09-11. Groups: agent infrastructure, cli tools, libraries, benchmarks, websites & apps, experiments & learning, forks, contributions.

## Agent infrastructure

ai-usage-optimizer — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/ai-usage-optimizer — Local-first usage tracker for AI subscriptions — polls real usage signals, Telegram alerts, recommends the provider with headroom
anti-babysitting-pipeline — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/anti-babysitting-pipeline — Deterministic support code for Hermes's autonomous Kanban supervisor — wakes the supervisor only when the board changes
auto-permissions — local only (coming soon) — ZCode plugin adding a Claude-Code-style auto permission classifier — safe actions auto-approved, dangerous ones denied with a reason
fleet-bus — local only (coming soon) — Low-latency push transport for the agent fleet — embedded NATS + JetStream, replayable history, one zero-dependency Go binary (v0.2)
hermes-classifier-mode — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/hermes-classifier-mode — Claude Code's auto permission mode for Hermes Agent — a local LLM classifier reviews every shell command before it runs (Ollama, on-device)
session-categorizer — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/session-categorizer — Deterministic, no-LLM categorizer for Hermes session databases — extracts decisions, constraints and blockers with citations
skills — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/skills — Personal agent-skill catalog, authored and battle-tested in real agent loops — skills.wesleymatos.dev
usage-dash — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/usage-dash — Read-only web dashboard over the local Hermes state DB and memoryos trace

## CLI tools

block-ads-huawei-router — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/block-ads-huawei-router — Just a simple app to fill all blocked IPs on huawei router
herdr-axi — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/herdr-axi — AXI-discipline wrapper around the herdr multiplexer CLI
ollama-axi — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/ollama-axi — Agent-grade model management for Ollama — gc orphaned blobs and aborted pulls, inspect the real store, reclaim dead weight
pages-proxy — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/pages-proxy — Tiny Rust Cloudflare Worker that reverse-proxies a custom domain/subdomain to a Cloudflare Pages project — no DNS edits needed
scp-axi — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/scp-axi — Unattended file transfer to SSH-key-authenticated hosts — no interactive prompts, dry-run default, human + --json output
session-rc — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/session-rc — Thin CLI to remote-control one exact live Hermes gateway session from a phone
set-all-gists-to-private — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/set-all-gists-to-private — Repository to set all my gists to private but this features isn't supported by github anymore :/
terminal-axi — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/terminal-axi — Agent-ergonomic terminal session control — one Rust binary, one JSON contract, no daemon; run foreground or spawn detached and poll
unfit-rs — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/unfit-rs — unf.it review tool — Rust rewrite: local-first visual review hub for iterating on websites with element-scoped feedback
xcap-recorder — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/xcap-recorder — Cross-platform screen recorder in Rust using xcap — records every display to a separate H.264 MP4 via FFmpeg
zcode-axi — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/zcode-axi — Machine-friendly control plane around the zcode runtime — deterministic parseable output, documented exit-code contract, never prompts

## Libraries

console-art — source not public — Render colored ASCII art safely in the browser console — one console.log per row, bounded %c runs
deno-data-structures — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/deno-data-structures — Data structures training repo. It's meant to showcase data structures implementations. Tests can be ran using `deno test`
hermes-agent-rs — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/hermes-agent-rs — Composable Rust libraries and agent tools for integrating with Hermes Agent — typed API client, HMAC webhooks, orchestration
sort-numbers — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/sort-numbers — Simple library to sort numbers in go

## Benchmarks

aux-bench — https://github.com/wesleymatosdev/aux-bench — Benchmark local Ollama models for Hermes auxiliary task slots — scores measured behavior (empty-content failures), not vibes
